review_candidates.title: Marketing Technology Manager
review_candidates.description: About the role We're looking for a hands-on MarTech Manager to help MASH and our clients get more from their CRM, marketing automation, data and wider martech ecosystem. This is not a platform administration role. You'll look at how the marketing engine works end to end, identify where technology or process is creating friction, recommend practical improvements, and then help make them happen. You'll work across CRM, marketing automation, integrations, campaign operations, analytics, tracking and reporting, helping connect systems so marketing teams can work more efficiently and make better decisions. You need to be comfortable moving between thinking and doing: bringing a clear point of view on what should change while being equally happy getting into the platforms, workflows and data yourself. CRM & Marketing Automation Review existing CRM and marketing technology stacks and identify opportunities to simplify, integrate or improve them. Manage and optimise CRM and marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo or equivalent. Build and optimise lead journeys, audience segments, automated workflows, forms, landing pages and email campaigns. Improve lead management, database structure, segmentation and handover between marketing and sales. Troubleshoot platform and integration issues and support the implementation of new tools where required. Campaign Operations & Digital Infrastructure Set up, test, launch and optimise digital marketing campaigns and associated workflows. Ensure campaigns, forms, pixels, links, audiences and tracking are configured correctly. Support website, CMS and landing-page improvements where required Work with marketing teams to improve on-page SEO fundamentals, including metadata, headings, internal linking, page structure and content optimisation. Make sure marketing activity is measurable and connected across systems. Work with marketing teams and specialists to ensure technology supports campaign delivery rather than slowing it down Data, Reporting & Optimisation Establish useful KPIs and reporting across CRM, campaigns, website and lead-generation activity. Build and maintain practical dashboards using tools such as GA4, Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio. Analyse marketing and customer data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations. Identify gaps in tracking, attribution or data quality and help resolve them. Use performance data to identify where processes, campaigns or technology can be improved. Automation, AI & Process Improvement Identify repetitive or fragmented marketing processes that can be simplified or automated. Build workflows connecting marketing platforms, teams and data using tools such as Zapier, Make or equivalent. Explore practical uses of AI-enabled marketing tools that improve speed, personalisation or effectiveness. Document systems and workflows so they are scalable, repeatable and easy for teams to use. Stay curious about emerging tools, but recommend technology based on genuine business value rather than novelty. Requirements About You You bring 6+ years of experience across marketing operations, CRM, marketing automation, MarTech, digital marketing or a related discipline. You have worked across more than one organisation, client or marketing environment and are comfortable adapting to different technology stacks and ways of working. You have strong hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo or similar. You are confident with marketing analytics and tracking tools such as GA4, Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio. You have practical experience with workflow and integration tools such as Zapier, Make or equivalent. You have a solid working understanding of SEO fundamentals, including on-page optimisation, technical SEO basics, keyword performance and organic traffic analysis. You understand the broader digital marketing ecosystem, including websites, email, paid media, lead generation and campaign analytics, without necessarily needing to be the channel specialist executing all of them. You can assess a marketing technology problem, recommend a sensible solution and then help implement it. You are comfortable interpreting marketing and customer data and explaining what it means to non-technical stakeholders. Experience using AI-enabled tools within marketing workflows is highly valuable. Basic HTML/CSS knowledge is useful. You can work independently, troubleshoot problems and make sound decisions without needing constant direction. You are commercially minded, curious and proactive, with a natural instinct to improve how things work. Please Note Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can't get back to every one of you, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we're hiring.

review_candidates.title: Finance Business Partner
review_candidates.description: 工作职责： 所负责区域全周期财务管控：熟悉“四算”（概预核决），全程跟进售前投标、合同签订、安装交付、验收回款全流程财务工作，负责合同财务评审、预算编制、成本预估、资源投入管控，从源头把控区域盈利与风险。 所负责区域经营分析与决策支撑：开展所负责区域经营数据分析、盈利复盘、毛利结构分析，按月输出区域经营分析报告、专项分析报告（如有）；总结区域经营痛点、盈利短板及运营问题，输出可落地的优化建议，为管理层战略审视、业务调整、定价、资源调配等提供数据支撑。 回款与资金风险管理：统筹区域应收账款管理，跟进客户文档签署、开票、回款全流程进度，制定回款推进计划；负责客户信用风险、渠道财务风险、合同付款条款风险排查，识别逾期、坏账隐患，联动业务团队推进回款落地，优化项目资金周转效率，严控经营资金风险。 编制年度商业计划：深度参与所负责区域商业计划编制、财务测算等。负责年度目标拆解、年度/季度经营指标规划，全程跟进商业计划落地执行，对比目标与实际经营偏差，动态复盘、给出订收回目标达成及盈利提升建议。 属地财务合规与政策遵从管理：全面负责区域财务合规与政策遵从工作，严格遵守当地财税法规、外汇管制及资金监管相关政策。与负责国别税务顾问日常沟通及问题解决，建立区域下属国财务合规自查机制，熟悉下属国税法及公司TP定价等，常态化审视税务、外汇、资金、关联交易等合规风险，杜绝违规操作与经营隐患。配合当地审查，保障区域财务工作合法合规、风险可控。 任职资格： 会计、财务、审计等相关专业本科以上学历 三年以上海外项目财务或者国家财务工作经验 熟练使用财务软件，熟练操作PPT、Excel、BI等软件，擅长财务分析模型搭建 工作细心、责任感强、目标感强，具备良好的团队合作意识和较强的跨部门沟通协助能力 英语为工作语言，掌握法语或阿拉伯语者优先；同时具备国际税务和经营管理经验者优先 接受外派工作安排
